pages.text: Guards protect the royal Fort and carry Hunter's Spears suited to both melee and throwing.$(br2)Their discipline makes them more than another wandering Grunt. A recovered spear can be improved with Barbed or Heavy Throw, and the two combine.
The spear is dangerous at every distance. Closing the gap is not the whole answer.

pages.title: Armored Hide
pages.text: Now and then a blow glances off a Guard's armor and does no damage at all, with a spark and a ring of steel. It cannot happen twice in a few seconds, so keep swinging.
